Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -6 & 3 & 2 \\ 4 & -1 & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ -1 & 5\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}-6 & 2 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}-6 & 3 \\ 4 & -1\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(3\cdot 5-2\cdot -1)i-(-6\cdot 5-2\cdot 4)j+(-6\cdot -1-3\cdot 4)k \\  & =(15+2)i-(-30-8)j+(6-12)k \\  & =17\,i+38\,j-6\,k\end{aligned}
$$
